requirement: The implementation binds to the 20-page footwear manual whose SHA-256 is 55f736db7b0bd2c6c32b97140c7d6400e03e2476a5deba2368168dcbf1905af9.
acceptance: The recorded hash equals the retrieved bytes before any derived work runs.
negative: A same-named file with different bytes fails closed.

requirement: The footwear manual supersedes the avatar manual only for shoe material, reflection, absorption, zoom, probe, glint, region, and shoe-specific quantitative rules.
acceptance: Ownership crosswalk retains every avatar contact and care floor.
negative: Material precedence cannot erase hand, tool, contact, or care motion.

requirement: A versioned care addendum must exist before care implementation begins.
acceptance: A complete candidate addendum defines every EVC-015-owned boundary.
negative: A UI or animation without the addendum is rejected.

requirement: Care owns state, tools, safety, stages, progress, completion, feedback, accessibility, and care evidence.
acceptance: Every field has one care owner and executable consumer.
negative: Renderer-owned stage or inferred tool fails.

requirement: Care state, footwear material conversion, and footwear fidelity selection remain three typed layers.
acceptance: Only typed interfaces cross layer boundaries.
negative: Care writes roughness or fidelity directly.

requirement: The reference branch claims zero production compliance and cannot unlock main or release.
acceptance: Docs and UI identify the pre-production boundary without implying conformance.
negative: Passing unit tests cannot set Verified or production-ready.

requirement: Mirror polish is limited to toe boxes, heel counters, and selected side surfaces of black dress or service footwear.
acceptance: Only registered rigid regions can receive mirror care.
negative: Flex, welt, seam, or sole receives mirror state.

requirement: The care sequence admits only explicitly confirmed compatible smooth finished leather and a compatible product profile.
acceptance: All confirmations are true before prepare is reachable.
negative: Unknown, suede, nubuck, patent, cordovan, exotic, oiled, damaged, or synthetic material enters care.

requirement: Material and product compatibility are explicit user facts, never image or history inference.
acceptance: No inference path exists in reducer or renderer.
negative: Color, filename, prior selection, or rendered appearance admits care.

requirement: Each shoe has dedicated mesh geometry rather than a generic foot shell or stroke.
acceptance: Toe, heel, upper, welt, and sole are independently inspectable geometry.
negative: SVG line, foot-shell recolor, or flat texture claims a shoe.

requirement: Foot bone plus heel, ball, and toe pivots are explicit and stable.
acceptance: Pivot manifest and transform tests pass for both shoes.
negative: One root pivot silently stands in for heel, ball, and toe.

requirement: Per-shoe sole contact markers are explicit and consumed by movement and care.
acceptance: Markers align with rendered sole contact in every supported pose.
negative: Contact is inferred from DOM position or shoe bounds.

requirement: Toe and heel curvature is actual geometry and inspection silhouette error remains below 0.25 output pixel.
acceptance: Golden silhouette measurement is below threshold.
negative: Normal map or shading hides missing curvature.

requirement: Continuous normals are preserved through every polished panel.
acceptance: Reflection-line checker has no unintended kink.
negative: Hard edge or tangent discontinuity interrupts reflection.

requirement: Seams, welt steps, toe-cap joins, leather thickness, and sole interfaces are geometry wherever they affect reflection.
acceptance: Each named feature exists in mesh inventory and inspection renders.
negative: Painted line substitutes for reflection-affecting construction.

requirement: Mirror, flex, seam/edge, and sole masks are independent and survive export.
acceptance: Mask channels have stable IDs and controlled blend bands only.
negative: One global gloss scalar drives the upper.

requirement: Mirror toe base roughness is within 0.12–0.18.
acceptance: Executing material readback is in range.
negative: Boundary-epsilon values outside the interval pass.

requirement: Mirror toe clearcoat is 0.98–1.00 and public coat roughness is 0.005–0.012.
acceptance: Both executing BRDF paths report values in range.
negative: Obsolete 0.0045–0.020 sample endpoints execute.

requirement: Mirror heel base roughness is 0.14–0.20, clearcoat 0.96–1.00, and coat roughness 0.007–0.016.
acceptance: Heel material readback meets all three intervals.
negative: Heel inherits toe or flex parameters.

requirement: Polished side base roughness is 0.16–0.23, clearcoat 0.90–1.00, and coat roughness 0.012–0.025.
acceptance: Side material readback meets all intervals.
negative: Side inherits whole-upper mirror state.

requirement: Vamp/flex base roughness is 0.24–0.38, clearcoat 0.45–0.75, and coat roughness 0.050–0.110.
acceptance: Flex material readback meets all intervals and remains at least three times the minimum toe coat roughness.
negative: Flex becomes an uninterrupted mirror.

requirement: Stitching/welt/edges base roughness is 0.35–0.60, clearcoat 0–0.25, and coat roughness 0.15–0.40.
acceptance: Construction material interrupts reflection within all intervals.
negative: Welt inherits mirror material.

requirement: Sole and heel rubber roughness is 0.60–0.85 with clearcoat exactly zero.
acceptance: Sole readback meets range and zero clearcoat.
negative: Sole reflects like polished leather.

requirement: Leather base color remains between sRGB #070707 and #0D0D0D and never literal black.
acceptance: Linearized base samples map to the permitted sRGB interval.
negative: #000000 hides buried detail or theme tokens recolor the shoe.

requirement: Metalness is exactly 0.0.
acceptance: Material and shader readback both equal zero.
negative: Chrome shortcut or nonzero metalness activates.

requirement: IOR remains within 1.48–1.55 with 1.52 as the baseline.
acceptance: Runtime material exposes finite in-range IOR.
negative: Out-of-range or non-finite IOR is accepted.

requirement: Specular intensity is 0.95–1.0 and specular color is neutral white.
acceptance: Readback is in range with equal RGB channels.
negative: Navy or cyan specular tint appears.

requirement: Transmission, iridescence, and sheen remain exactly zero.
acceptance: All three runtime fields equal zero.
negative: Glass, oil-film, or cloth-layer shortcut activates.

requirement: Mirror-region roughness controls use at least 16-bit or float precision.
acceptance: Asset metadata and shader path prove precision.
negative: Casual 8-bit full-range control is accepted.

requirement: Leather grain remains visible while clearcoat normal variation stays restrained.
acceptance: Inspection render exposes grain between reflected forms without broken reflection.
negative: Perfectly clean normals read as patent leather.

requirement: Micro-swirls are 5–25 micrometer-equivalent roughness/normal modulation and are never pale albedo scratches.
acceptance: Scale metadata and channel inspection pass.
negative: Pale scratch pixels exist in albedo.

requirement: Admiral blue affects only minute absorption in the buried dark lobe and never albedo, reflection, glint, or silhouette.
acceptance: Shader dataflow confines absorption before reflected-light composition.
negative: Blue is visible in any forbidden channel.

requirement: Average neutral-scene chroma C*ab remains below 2.
acceptance: Every registered mask produces C*ab < 2.
negative: 2.000 or greater passes.

requirement: Blue shift against neutral black remains below Delta E00 1.5 at normal viewing size.
acceptance: Every registered view produces Delta E00 < 1.5.
negative: 1.500 or greater passes.

requirement: No isolated non-reflection pixel reads as navy.
acceptance: Post-tone-map non-reflection samples remain neutral black.
negative: Cool reflected content is misclassified as shoe tint or navy base passes.

requirement: The renderer separates buried black leather, coherent scene reflection, and pin glint.
acceptance: Three independent paths can be isolated and measured.
negative: One highlight texture stands in for all phenomena.

requirement: PMREM supplies diffuse and rough base response but is never the sole macro mirror source.
acceptance: Sharp reflection remains independently present at inspection scale.
negative: Zoom reveals only enlarged PMREM blur.

requirement: A raw HDR local cube with preserved mip 0 and box projection supplies off-screen clearcoat reflection.
acceptance: Cube metadata, box projection, and off-screen landmark tests pass.
negative: Distant unprojected cube swims around near geometry.

requirement: Near-field reflection covers trousers, floor, other shoe, and local props with confidence-weighted cube fallback.
acceptance: Valid hits use near-field data and invalid hits use the cube.
negative: SSR-only loses off-screen content or screen-sticks.

requirement: The target shoe is hidden during its own cube capture.
acceptance: Capture-layer trace excludes target shoe ID.
negative: Self-reflection feedback enters the cube.

requirement: The other polished shoe uses a rough proxy during capture to prevent recursion.
acceptance: Capture trace swaps only the non-target shoe material and restores it.
negative: Recursive mirror feedback or missing other-shoe silhouette.

requirement: Reflection capture includes real windows, mullions, floor seams, lamps, silhouettes, and architecture.
acceptance: Every named landmark is scene geometry or radiance content.
negative: Painted reflection card or shoe texture supplies a landmark.

requirement: UI, bloom, helpers, reflection cards, direct-light proxies, and composite grain are excluded from probes.
acceptance: Layer trace excludes every forbidden source.
negative: UI text or grain appears in reflection.

requirement: Reflection composition follows world normals, box projection, footprint-safe LOD, near-field confidence, dielectric clearcoat, separate pin glint, one tone map, then sRGB output.
acceptance: Executing pass order matches the registered order.
negative: Tone mapping, tint, or glint is applied in the wrong stage.

requirement: The direct glint source has 0.2–0.5 degree apparent size and is not an elongated source.
acceptance: Source geometry and camera measurement meet range.
negative: Strip light or softbox paints a broad band.

requirement: Exposure remains fixed through camera zoom and care progression.
acceptance: Exposure trace is constant across the zoom/care matrix.
negative: Blackness is rescued by auto exposure.

requirement: Bloom is off for the shoe or keeps the glint halo within 1–1.5 output pixels.
acceptance: Measured halo meets the stricter configured limit.
negative: Bloom widens the glint into a band.

requirement: Pshoe is the conservative maximum final-presentation-pixel extent across both shoes and all active direct views, independent of internal scale.
acceptance: Selector consumes physical presentation pixels and maximum extent.
negative: World distance, CSS pixels, one shoe, or dynamic render pixels select fidelity.

requirement: SF0 applies only when Pshoe < 96.
acceptance: 95.999 selects SF0 and 96 does not.
negative: Exact 96 remains in SF0.

requirement: SF1 applies exactly when 96 <= Pshoe < 256.
acceptance: 96 and 255.999 select SF1; 256 does not.
negative: Boundary ownership drifts by rounding.

requirement: SF2 applies exactly when 256 <= Pshoe < 640.
acceptance: 256 and 639.999 select SF2; 640 does not.
negative: Boundary ownership drifts by rounding.

requirement: SF3 applies exactly when 640 <= Pshoe < 1200.
acceptance: 640 and 1199.999 select SF3; 1200 does not.
negative: Inspection enters below SF3.

requirement: SF4 applies when Pshoe >= 1200.
acceptance: 1200 and larger finite values select SF4.
negative: 1200 remains in SF3 or non-finite input is accepted.

requirement: Required tier is the maximum of pixel tier, roughness tier, and SF3 while inspection is active.
acceptance: Every ordering permutation selects the finest demand.
negative: Device tier or environment LOD caps shoe fidelity.

requirement: Each 2x increase in projected shoe size reveals an additional octave of real reflection or material information until source cap.
acceptance: 64–2048 pixel series reveals registered new landmarks/details at each doubling.
negative: The same blur is merely enlarged.

requirement: The selected mip maintains 2–4 effective source texels per final shoe pixel for every visible material region.
acceptance: UV-to-screen Jacobian measurements pass for every region.
negative: Base texture resolution is used as a proxy for effective mip density.

requirement: Probe and texture transitions span at least 0.2 log2(Pshoe) only when both complete tiers pass parity.
acceptance: Transition trace meets width and parity preconditions with no pop.
negative: Partial resource crossfade or visible mip pop.

requirement: Requested zoom and tier remain distinct from presented zoom and tier until hash-validated complete resources are resident.
acceptance: Presented state holds the last valid view through prepare, fail, retry, and cancel.
negative: Under-tier source, partial cubemap, blur upscale, or negative mip bias is shown.

requirement: Care state includes monotonic revision, run, status, stage, shoe, region, tool, contact, four regional amounts, requested/presented motion, message, and error.
acceptance: Schema requires every field and rejects extras that alter semantics.
negative: A renderer-local or partial state is treated as canonical.

requirement: Every accepted semantic transition increments revision exactly once.
acceptance: Reducer trace is strictly monotonic without gaps for one event.
negative: Animation frames or rejected events increment revision.

requirement: Each care amount is finite and within [0,1]; invalid input fails before material activation and is never clamped.
acceptance: 0 and 1 pass; negative epsilon, 1+epsilon, NaN, infinities, null, and strings fail.
negative: Math clamp repairs invalid authority.

requirement: Toe roughness conversion uses shared float32 order toe = mix(0.005, 0.012, a*a).
acceptance: Reference vectors and readback match float32 computation.
negative: Obsolete endpoints, clamping, or backend-specific formula executes.

requirement: Flex roughness conversion uses shared float32 order flex = mix(0.050, 0.110, a).
acceptance: Reference vectors and readback match float32 computation.
negative: Flex inherits toe formula or mirror amount.

requirement: Compatibility reaches prepare only after explicit material, product-label, and hidden-area confirmations.
acceptance: Reducer rejects START unless all confirmations are true.
negative: One or two confirmations suffice.

requirement: Prepare reaches apply only after laces/debris and dryness are explicitly confirmed.
acceptance: Reducer requires both preparation facts.
negative: Elapsed time or visual cleanliness advances.

requirement: Normal care motion keeps hand, cloth, selected rigid region, and semantic contact coupled.
acceptance: Every working frame has registered tool-to-region contact within tolerance.
negative: Hovering cloth, detached hand, wrong shoe, or wrong region progresses.

requirement: Authored cloth travel is 8–18 mm and reverses roughly 3–5 Hz in Normal.
acceptance: Measured animation extrema and reversal rate meet both ranges.
negative: Large circles, one pass, or user precision gesture substitutes.

requirement: At least one valid contact cycle is required before work can reach water or set.
acceptance: Reducer rejects advancement with zero valid cycles.
negative: Timer or visual frame count advances state.

requirement: Water assistance is one drop only when the product label permits and no invented temperature is presented.
acceptance: Reachable operative copy contains the product-label condition and no heat directive.
negative: ‘Hot’, ‘warm’, or metaphor carries temperature/material safety.

requirement: Set reaches finish only after explicit user confirmation of the product-directed wait.
acceptance: No timer auto-advances and confirmation is required.
negative: Background timer or animation completion asserts drying.

requirement: Back returns to a safe boundary without decreasing care amount or claiming to undo physical application.
acceptance: Amounts remain monotonic and copy states the physical limit.
negative: Back subtracts applied care or hides the consequence.

requirement: Pause and Cancel release contact before state changes.
acceptance: Event trace contains RELEASE before PAUSE or CANCEL commit.
negative: Tool freezes in contact after cancellation.

requirement: Shoe, region, tool, or motion-mode changes during contact are rejected until release.
acceptance: Every mid-contact mutation returns unchanged state with recovery.
negative: ABA change commits stale contact to a new target.

requirement: Completion means only that the modeled sequence reached final release and never asserts restoration, protection, freedom from damage, or an optical threshold.
acceptance: All completion transcripts preserve the bounded claim.
negative: ‘Restored’, ‘protected’, ‘inspection-ready’, or guaranteed finish appears.

requirement: Reduced preserves every care stage and contact truth with a slower bounded approach-contact-release track and no rapid reversal, shimmer, or inertia.
acceptance: Stage and semantic outputs equal Normal while secondary motion is absent.
negative: Reduced skips stages or substitutes completion.

requirement: Still exposes contact-safe representative phases and explicit Previous/Next controls without autonomous care-clock advance.
acceptance: 300 frames remain stable and phase changes require user input.
negative: Still is a final-frame freeze or care timer continues.

requirement: Reduced motion, Still, Reduced Effects, high contrast, and forced colors preserve spatial reflection fidelity, topology, silhouette, sole, contact shadow, written state, and nonvisual feedback.
acceptance: Mode matrix retains every essential output.
negative: A mode replaces the shoe with flat black or deletes reflection landmarks.

requirement: Contact, timing, accessibility, safety, material limits, order, stop, and recovery content is immediately legible Operative copy.
acceptance: Every protected fact appears literally in the first presented layer.
negative: Metaphor, color, animation, tooltip, or optional explanation carries a protected fact.

requirement: Eligible Catalysis care language is optional and preserves exact semantic-fact equality with canonical copy.
acceptance: Fact projections are exactly equal before styling is exposed.
negative: Tone softens, adds, reorders, or contradicts a fact.

requirement: The mirror finish is never the only cue for shoe identity, region, contact, progress, or completion.
acceptance: Text and shape expose every state with reflection hidden.
negative: Removing color/motion makes two states indistinguishable.

requirement: Keyboard, touch, switch, and voice can complete the full sequence without rubbing, dragging, hovering, color recognition, or timed input.
acceptance: Input-path matrix reaches identical semantic completion.
negative: Pointer gesture is the only progress path.

requirement: Written and on-demand state names shoe, region, tool, contact, stage, progress, availability, and next action from one revision.
acceptance: Every consumer reports the same revision and values.
negative: Visual and nonvisual consumers diverge or infer certainty.

requirement: Unsolicited progress is polite, atomic, run-scoped, revalidated, and no more frequent than once per second; contact loss and failure use assertive alerts.
acceptance: Announcement trace meets rate, priority, cancellation, and relevance rules.
negative: 3–5 Hz cloth reversals chatter or stale progress announces after completion.

requirement: Care progress and history remain memory-only and are absent from local storage, network output, analytics, and profile records.
acceptance: Reload discards care and source/network/storage audits find no persistence path.
negative: Care state is added to appearance preferences or telemetry.

requirement: Pixels above 95% peak occupy at most 0.05% of a nonempty visible polished mask.
acceptance: Mask-qualified pixel measurement is <= threshold.
negative: Empty mask or rounded denominator passes.

requirement: Pixels above 80% peak occupy at most 0.15% of a nonempty visible polished mask.
acceptance: Mask-qualified pixel measurement is <= threshold.
negative: Broad highlight passes through denominator dilution.

requirement: Glint core diameter is 0.5–1.5% and halo at most 2.5% of toe-cap width.
acceptance: Every camera and tier meets both ratios.
negative: Large hot patch or bloom band passes.

requirement: Recognizable scene structure occupies at least 60% of rigid toe/heel polished masks in the calibration hall.
acceptance: Independent landmark review and mask metric meet threshold.
negative: Black-pixel-dominated metric or self-authored labels pass.

requirement: At 512 px, mullions and floor seams are separable; at 1024 px, secondary architecture becomes newly readable.
acceptance: Frozen targets and independent review confirm both observations.
negative: Upscaled blur or authored expected labels pass.

requirement: Downsampled adjacent zoom tiers achieve SSIM >= 0.97 inside balanced shoe-region masks and mean luminance changes less than 1%.
acceptance: Every adjacent 64–2048 pair passes both metrics.
negative: Empty/background-heavy masks or averaged failures pass.

requirement: Valid near-field ray error is below 1 degree; landmark error is below 2 px for near-field and below 6 px for probe fallback at 512 px.
acceptance: Analytic and rendered fixtures pass independently.
negative: Averages conceal a failed landmark.

requirement: Still-camera luma RMS is below 0.5% across 120 frames and Still mode remains stable across 300 frames.
acceptance: Every nonempty mask and run passes independently.
negative: Run averaging or excluded sparkle passes.

requirement: Reflected features trail no more than 2 px after a 90 degree/second orbit and no autonomous sparkle, twinkle, or glint exists.
acceptance: Orbit trace and static-seed run pass.
negative: Random or clock-driven highlight moves with no scene cause.

requirement: Average reflection cost is at most 2.0 ms desktop, 2.5 ms mobile, and 8 ms while inspection settles.
acceptance: Each registered device run meets its applicable budget.
negative: Required passes are removed to meet budget.

requirement: Every supported device/browser/backend pair passes the exact physical-anchor soak and three 180-second run protocol.
acceptance: Each run independently meets frame-interval and rolling-window gates.
negative: Class labels, averages, discarded throttled runs, or UA allowlists stand in for evidence.

requirement: Every correction preserves issue, constraint, decision, implementation, failed test, correction, and verification.
acceptance: Each resolved defect links all seven stages without overwrite.
negative: Only the final passing test remains.

requirement: DOM labels, data attributes, source regexes, static images, and structural tests cannot claim absent executed geometry, contact, reflection, accessibility, or material mechanisms.
acceptance: Every compliance claim cites executed observable evidence.
negative: Presence of a class or label is counted as visual/physical verification.

requirement: Footwear material identity is isolated from theme, text, ink, currentColor, and forced-color tokens; ordinary rendered leather remains neutral black in every theme.
acceptance: Theme/mode matrix leaves physical material parameters byte-identical outside registered accessibility transforms.
negative: Dark mode or inherited currentColor turns leather white, colored, or transparent.

requirement: No CSS gradient, SVG highlight, matcap, decal, reflection card, baked landmark, or screen/UV-fixed shape may supply shoe reflection.
acceptance: Source audit and perturbation captures prove all reflected landmarks originate in scene radiance.
negative: A stationary landmark survives independent camera, shoe, or environment movement.

requirement: The reference route must render actual 3D shoe geometry through a WebGL physical-material path; a canvas fallback may report unavailability but may not claim the optical result.
acceptance: Capability success creates meshes, materials, lights, camera, and reflection resources; failure exposes literal Unavailable state.
negative: Static SVG/image is silently substituted as compliant footwear.
evidence: runtime resource trace and failure fixture

requirement: Every visible material region retains independent mesh/mask and parameter ownership through care changes.
acceptance: A care update changes only the selected rigid region's care input; all other readbacks remain unchanged.
negative: One scalar or material replacement alters the whole upper.

requirement: Every percentage metric rejects an empty mask and requires registered minimum pixel coverage for its view and tier.
acceptance: Empty, one-pixel, and below-coverage masks fail before metric calculation.
negative: Zero numerator over zero/tiny denominator passes.

requirement: Zoom similarity and landmark metrics use nonempty balanced per-region masks and report every rigid region separately.
acceptance: Toe and heel each pass without background or sole dilution.
negative: A large black background hides a failed reflection.

requirement: Color tests separately mask buried diffuse, reflected radiance, pin glint, and non-reflection output after tone mapping.
acceptance: Every channel and mask independently satisfies its applicable neutrality rule.
negative: Cool windows excuse blue base or aggregate chroma hides tinted glint.

requirement: Camera, shoe, and environment perturbations independently distinguish PMREM, sharp local, near-field, and fallback behavior.
acceptance: Each path passes its own causal perturbation oracle.
negative: Subjective single-view review substitutes for path causality.

requirement: A probe becomes presentable only after all six faces share one semantic revision and time sample and swap atomically from a back buffer.
acceptance: Face manifest is complete, revision-equal, and atomically swapped.
negative: Any partial or mixed-revision cubemap is sampled.

requirement: Probe capture restores target visibility, proxy materials, layers, and renderer state in a guaranteed cleanup path after success, error, cancellation, or context loss.
acceptance: Fault injection at each capture step restores the exact pre-capture state.
negative: Hidden target or rough proxy leaks into presentation.

requirement: Every asynchronous resource request carries generation, semantic revision, shoe, scene, view, DPR, Pshoe, mode, and tier identity and commits only if all still match.
acceptance: ABA and reordering fixtures keep the last valid presentation and reject stale completion.
negative: Old resources commit after a newer request restores the same apparent values.

requirement: Probe invalidation compares against the last captured origin so cumulative translation, rotation, geometry motion, or light change cannot evade thresholds.
acceptance: Repeated subthreshold deltas invalidate when cumulative displacement reaches the registered threshold.
negative: Only adjacent-frame deltas are measured.

requirement: Context loss invalidates all GPU residency and re-enters the same fail-closed preparation transaction before presentation resumes.
acceptance: Loss/restore retains last valid non-WebGL state, rebuilds complete resources, and atomically recommits.
negative: Partial or stale resources reappear after restore.

requirement: Mount, unmount, and Strict Mode remount create exactly one loop/listener set and dispose every renderer, texture, target, material, geometry, and observer.
acceptance: Lifecycle counters return to zero after unmount and one after remount.
negative: Duplicate render loop, listener, GPU object, or announcement persists.

requirement: The footwear/care route performs no network fetch, remote model/texture/HDR load, telemetry, or logging; required resources are bundled or generated locally.
acceptance: Source and runtime network audit find no route-owned request.
negative: CDN asset, analytics beacon, or console trace exists.

requirement: careAmount is labeled and exposed only as modeled demonstration state, never measured physical coverage, layer count, optical grade, or outcome.
acceptance: All visual and nonvisual transcripts use bounded modeled-state language.
negative: Percent complete is presented as a claim about the user's shoe.

requirement: Only accepted care-domain events may change stage, contact, valid-cycle count, or careAmount; renderer time and pointer distance are read-only presentation inputs.
acceptance: Advancing all timers and animation frames without an event leaves semantic state byte-identical.
negative: animationend, requestAnimationFrame, CSS iteration, or drag distance advances care.

requirement: Every physical instruction is scoped to an explicitly selected registered compatibility profile and defers to its current label and warnings.
acceptance: Unknown or different product makes physical procedure unavailable.
negative: Amiral-specific water or dry guidance is generalized.

requirement: The source phrase hot-water-assisted remains provenance only; reachable copy contains no heat instruction and permits one clean-water drop only under the selected product label.
acceptance: Exact reachable-copy scan and human comprehension review find no temperature inference.
negative: Warm/hot/wake/heat metaphor carries operative meaning.

requirement: A change to a more protective motion mode releases contact first and atomically commits a contact-safe representative before the new mode is presented.
acceptance: Event order is RELEASE then mode transaction, with one semantic revision per boundary.
negative: Tool teleports, clips, or remains in contact across mode swap.

requirement: Every care surface and control is excluded from the guide's ambient click-reaction handler.
acceptance: Pointer/keyboard activation changes only the intended care state.
negative: Care input also waves or retimes the guide.

requirement: Leaving or unmounting the care route synchronously releases contact and pauses or cancels the run before presentation changes.
acceptance: Route transition trace contains release and no active contact remains.
negative: Offscreen care continues or stale contact resumes silently.

requirement: Care types and state are absent from AvatarConfig, appearance persistence, chess persistence, and every local-storage migration.
acceptance: Roundtrip storage tests preserve preferences while dropping any injected care field.
negative: Care progress survives reload or reset boundary.

requirement: The complete footwear denominator enumerates left/right, movement/inspection/care, front/profile/rear/45, standing/seated/access adaptations, compact/primary/peer/fallback, themes, modes, tiers, and backends; unevidenced cells remain blockers.
acceptance: Matrix has no implicit inheritance or omitted cell.
negative: One hero render grants coverage to another consumer.

requirement: Canvas, DOM status, controls, Wayfinder, announcements, and on-demand description consume one immutable semantic snapshot revision.
acceptance: Injected consumer delay or failure yields Unavailable rather than mixed revisions.
negative: A fresh canvas and stale text, or vice versa, is presented as coherent.

requirement: Until independent semantic classification and comprehension evidence passes, reachable care copy remains plain Operative-only and no candidate flag can authorize Catalysis styling.
acceptance: Reachable transcript contains no Experiential or Interpretive dependency and every protected fact is literal.
negative: Expected flags, labels, or schema validity stand in for comprehension.

requirement: Compute tier, motion/effects mode, pressure, or performance code may alter only equal-fidelity scheduling and never lower required optical, topological, semantic, contact, or accessibility output.
acceptance: Every degradation request either preserves all gates or enters explicit Unavailable without moving presented state.
negative: Flat black, widened shine, missing landmark, reduced map, or removed cue is exposed.

requirement: Build, unit, source, and reference-render passes never change inherited blockers, Verified count, production lock, or merge/release eligibility.
acceptance: Evidence summary reports candidate status and every unevidenced gate after successful checks.
negative: Green CI is described as specification compliance or completion.

requirement: The failed 1.0 care candidate remains immutable evidence and the 1.1 candidate supersedes only enumerated clauses while every manual and addendum byte identity is pinned.
acceptance: Generated provenance lists exact hashes for both manuals and both care addenda without rewriting the prior files.
negative: A mutable URL, same-named file, or retroactive baseline edit silently changes authority.

requirement: Canonical care state includes targetLocked and cycleRecordedThisPass, is exact-key and reducer-issued, and rejects reconstructed histories or copy even when structurally identical.
acceptance: Exact schema, state-coherence, forged-finish, forged-cycle, and forged-message tests reject unchanged.
negative: A caller fabricates Finish, Complete, progress proof, or operative copy with an object literal.

requirement: Every event has only own enumerable registered string keys plus exact run and revision identity; a functional latest-state compare-and-swap store rejects concurrent stale commits.
acceptance: Extra, inherited, non-enumerable, symbol, stale-run, stale-revision, and two-from-one-snapshot events reject with the identical state.
negative: Prototype or descriptor tricks bypass the event schema, or two stale UI callbacks both commit.

requirement: Shoe and region remain selectable only until preparation commits targetLocked; the locked target cannot change later in the run even after Back or release.
acceptance: Early target selection passes and every post-lock selection rejects while all four modeled values remain unchanged.
negative: A global stage is reused as if it represented independent concurrent shoe waits or passes.

requirement: A reducer-owned modeled contact record advances only the locked target by deterministic 0.125, and Water additionally requires current-pass proof, presently felt resistance, and current-label permission for one clean-water drop.
acceptance: Historical progress, absent resistance, absent label permission, caller-supplied amounts, and saturated Water reject; a valid water authorization is consumed on return to Work.
negative: Historical value or an arbitrary absolute amount authorizes water, set, or physical claims.
evidence: cycle, water, saturation, and exact-event tests

requirement: The reviewed Saphir profile requires an explicitly confirmed 30-minute final dry with no brushing, followed only by a light pass with the current label's named Saphir Lustreur Glove.
acceptance: Reachable Set and Finish copy names the profile, current label, no-brush boundary, and Lustreur Glove; no timer infers the wait.
negative: A generic finishing cloth, brush, another worked layer, or elapsed animation completes the run.

requirement: Complete is terminal except Restart and reports all modeled targets, untreated regions, and that physical finish is not measured or declared.
acceptance: Back, target, mode, pause, and care events reject from Complete; the final report contains no physical or optical outcome claim.
negative: Complete reopens the run or implies restored, protected, inspection-ready, or measured footwear.

requirement: A future production consumer transaction must bind render request and acknowledgement to run, revision, target, motion, resource generation, and required/presented tier before visual and semantic state can claim parity.
acceptance: Injected stale, missing, failed, and out-of-tier acknowledgements expose visual Unavailable without moving the semantic revision.
negative: A revisionless WebGL boolean or late resource callback is presented as the current care snapshot.

requirement: The procedural WebGL shoe is labeled unrated with no presented ShoeFidelityTier and cannot satisfy SF0 or any production optical tier.
acceptance: UI, data attributes, documentation, and tests say unrated while fidelity selectors retain exact SF0-SF4 demand boundaries separately.
negative: SF0 is used as a procedural-quality badge without measuring Pshoe or acknowledging presented resources.

requirement: Still exposes explicit representative phase and description controls without semantic progress; unsolicited announcements are run/revision scoped and at most once per second; failure recovery is assertive and nonduplicative.
acceptance: Executed focus, phase, announcement-rate, failure-priority, input, zoom, forced-colors, and assistive-technology traces pass.
negative: Static SSR labels, source presence, or a canvas pose are treated as executed accessibility equivalence.

requirement: Requirement scope disposition remains separate from implementation evidence; each correction links issue, constraint, decision, failed reproduction, correction, verification, and remaining blocker without self-attesting Verified status.
acceptance: Register schemas and hashes are independently recomputed and an ID-linked evidence map preserves every failure and residual blocker.
negative: Green source or unit tests overwrite a failed baseline, manufacture Verified rows, or unlock production.
evidence: postimplementation report, evidence map, and independent register tests

requirement: Canonical admission, authored assets, contact and kinematic measurement, full reflection transactions, tier residency, whole-consumer coverage, optical/device/accessibility evidence, and independent review remain blockers after the reference passes software checks.
acceptance: Summary retains zero Verified and productionUnlocked false while every named denominator remains visible.
negative: A working reference route, build, unit suite, or structural regex is described as specification completion.

requirement: The author's explicit decision authorizes committing and pushing the reviewed footwear implementation and merging its source branch into Evenward main, superseding only the earlier main-merge prohibition.
acceptance: The integration record identifies the reviewed source commit, remote push, target main branch, and merge result without changing any production or Verified field.
negative: A green check authorizes an unreviewed merge, or the authorized source merge is described as a production release.
evidence: git commit, remote-ref, and merge transcript
supersession: supersedes only EVW-FP-AUTH-006's main-unlock prohibition and EVW-FP-RT-028's merge-ineligibility phrase after direct author authorization; release and production rules remain

requirement: A separate public GitHub repository named ShoeCareStudio may publish the bounded standalone extraction and may commit, push, and merge that reviewed source to its main branch independently of the Evenward-main operation.
acceptance: The public repository URL has the exact repository name ShoeCareStudio, visibility PUBLIC, and a merged reviewed main ref whose commit is recorded, whether or not the separately authorized Evenward merge has completed.
negative: A private, differently named, unmerged, untraceable, or Evenward-merge-dependent repository is reported as the requested public project.
evidence: GitHub repository metadata and ref transcript
supersession: adds independent author-approved public standalone distribution without changing production eligibility

requirement: Original ShoeCareStudio software is offered under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, with no repository-level license or metadata that grants commercial use; separable original documentation may use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and third-party terms remain unchanged.
acceptance: The public repository contains the complete PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 terms, identifies that license in package and README metadata, maps separable documentation explicitly, and contains no conflicting permissive commercial-use grant for original software.
negative: The repository is labeled MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, generic open source, or otherwise grants commercial use to the original software.
evidence: license-file, package-metadata, README, and repository-license audit

locator: exact public metadata; unchanged claim boundary
requirement: The public repository description is exactly 'A local-first, accessibility-oriented pre-production leather shoe-care reference with fail-closed care semantics and a procedural Three.js renderer.'; topics are exactly leather-care, shoe-care, threejs, webgl, nextjs, react, typescript, accessibility, local-first, privacy, source-available, and noncommercial; no homepage is set until a standalone deployment exists.
acceptance: A GitHub metadata query returns the exact description, exact topic set, PUBLIC visibility, and an empty homepage, while the README says accessibility-oriented and pre-production without claiming conformance.
negative: Metadata says accessible or compliant, changes the description/topic set, advertises an undeployed homepage, or launders public visibility into a measured shoe finish.
evidence: GitHub description, topics, homepage, visibility, and README claim audit

requirement: Closed v1.0-v1.2 candidates, red-team reports, registers, deltas, and summaries remain byte-preserved; the ledger retains its pre-v1.3 bytes as an exact prefix, while the append-only ledger and active evidence map may receive additive v1.3 entries.
acceptance: Hard-coded hashes cover every closed footwear artifact through v1.2, the ledger begins with the hard-coded pre-v1.3 prefix, and v1.3 is exactly the canonical v1.2 register followed by the canonical integration delta.
negative: Earlier prohibition wording or a closed failed artifact is edited in place, the ledger prefix changes, or active additive evidence is incorrectly required to remain byte-static.
evidence: independent closed-artifact hashes, ledger-prefix check, and append-only composition test

requirement: Author-approved commit, push, merge, and public repository operations remain independent of canonical admission, release, deployment, compliance, inherited blockers, Verified status, and production unlock.
acceptance: The v1.3 summary retains 42 inherited blockers, zero Verified, and productionUnlocked false after all authorized repository operations succeed.
negative: A public repository, main-branch merge, GitHub success response, or green build reduces the blocker denominator or is reported as a production release.
evidence: register summary and post-integration claim audit
supersession: separates author-granted source integration from unchanged release and production gates

requirement: The final integration evidence joins the independently authorized Evenward and standalone operations by recording exact commit identities, target branches, push and merge outcomes, public URL, visibility, default branch, license, description, topics, and homepage without treating those repository facts as product acceptance evidence.
acceptance: A dated operational record independently resolves every enumerated field from git and GitHub after each applicable operation completes and repeats the zero-Verified production lock.
negative: Success is asserted from local intent, an unqueried remote, mutable UI recollection, dependence of one authorized operation on the other, or a repository fact substituted for missing physical, optical, accessibility, device, or independent-review evidence.
evidence: post-operation git and GitHub metadata transcript

requirement: The standalone package is named shoe-care-studio with display name ShoeCareStudio; it includes the care Studio/renderer, care state/store/material domains, focused footwear tests, register/evidence set, complete applicable noncommercial license suite, and only the minimal shell/styles/build configuration they require, while excluding Evenward trainer/avatar, chess, regulation-practice catalog, deployment configuration, and domains.
acceptance: A manifest and path audit finds every required care, test, register, evidence, and license surface; exact package/display names; no excluded Evenward product or deployment surface; and a passing standalone build and focused suite.
negative: A renamed full Evenward clone, incomplete care extraction, missing evidence/license surface, Evenward domain/deployment carryover, or mismatched package identity is published as ShoeCareStudio.
evidence: standalone manifest, path-denominator, build, and focused-test audit
